caption:
BETTER THAN ANY RESTAURANT'S, TOMATO BRUSCHETTA 

This recipe is perfect for parties at home when you don't want to spend the night in the kitchen serving out food constantly. all parts can be done in advance and served up easily :) 

My signature Ella's Tips are mentioned on the blog :) 

Ingredients: 
- 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
- 6 garlic cloves, sliced
- 6 small tomatoes OR 4 medium tomatoes, deseeded and cut into cubes
- 1 tsp salt
- 10 basil leaves, sliced thin
- 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar ( i like 3 tbsp because BALSAMIC IS THE BEST)

Method: 
-start by adding your garlic and olive oil to a pan and let it heat slowly on the stove till the garlic starts changing colour ( in traditional bruschetta you would remove this mix of the heat before changing colour, in my recipe i do not do that and let the garlic get nice a crisp, this adds SOO much texture to your final dish
- while the garlic + oil is cooling, chop up your tomatoes and basil and keep it ready
- in a medium bowl, combine your tomatoes + basil + salt + garlic oil + balsamic  and leave in the fridge for an hour minimum. this develops the best flavour between all the ingredients
- while the mix is chilling, toast your bread in the oven at 180 degrees c until it gets crispy
- top with your tomato mix and serve it fresh.
